mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an accommodative monetary policy shift, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1% over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.5% over three consecutive months indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE rises above 5.5% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and new housing starts (HOUST) signal a broad-based weakening in consumer and housing demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST decline by at least 0.5% from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% year-over-year), a rise in the federal funds rate signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing real borrowing costs and reducing equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0% and FEDFUNDS rises by at least 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 105.0 indicates robust manufacturing activity and economic expansion, boosting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 45% of periods when INDPRO rises above 105.0 for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below 430,000 million dollars signals weakening consumer spending, reducing corporate sales and earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS falls below 430,000 million dollars.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.5%), a rise in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 150,000 jobs signals a strengthening labor market, boosting consumer confidence and spending, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: high unemployment with labor market recovery
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.5% and PAYEMS rises by at least 100,000 jobs.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) and rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 0.5%) signal a tightening monetary policy cycle, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5% and FEDFUNDS rises above 0.5%.
